parsed.explanation: Traveller-facing exposures are largely absent. No presentation offence, no birth-sex facility or custody rule (placement is case-by-case with sheltering of disclosed trans detainees), and anti-discrimination law covers gender identity in goods and services, with hate-crime aggravation for 'change of sex'. The 2018 declaration procedure needs no medical steps. Open questions weigh lightly: foreign-document acceptance, border treatment and hospital ward placement are undocumented, not shown to be harmful. Residual gaps include unprotected gender expression, under-reporting noted in 2019, no current enforcement data, and an unclear July 2025 action plan. Social acceptance is only indirectly evidenced (associations welcomed reform, equality body and LGBTIQ+ services exist). Nonbinary-marker absence and conversion/intersex gaps are resident-facing and not deducted. Band: reduced risk, a step below the strongest documented tier.
